name: Onsen de Takkyuu
source:
The protagonist Takuya who wants to befriend Miya, plans a trip to the hot springs.
Takuya also invites the Ikeuchi sisters in order to lure out Miya.
However, Aya Ikeuchi feeling like a lesbian is also aiming for Miya.
Takuya must win the table tennis tournament to earn the right to share a room with Miya.
